title: Ka-Zar the Savage #28 Marvel Comics October 1983 Shanna Bronze Age Comic
conditionDescription: Covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spine and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Ka-Zar the Savage #28 (October 1983), Marvel Comics, with Shanna the She-Devil. 75 cent cover price.
